register.title: Create account
register.loginLink: Already have an account? Log in

codesStep.title: Save your recovery codes
codesStep.intro: These six one-time codes are the only way back into your account if you forget your password. Save them somewhere safe now — they are shown only this once and Herokeep never stores them.

confirmLeave.title: Leave without saving your codes?
confirmLeave.message: These recovery codes will never be shown again. If you leave now without saving them, you could lose access to your account if you forget your password.

recover.title: Recover account
recover.codeHint: Enter one of the six recovery codes you saved when you registered.
recover.signOutNotice: Resetting your password will sign you out of every other device.

validation.invalidUsername: Usernames are 3–32 letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens.
validation.tooShort: Password must be at least 10 characters.
validation.tooLong: Password must be at most 128 characters.
validation.common: That password is too common — please choose another.
validation.containsUsername: Password must not contain your username.

errors.lockout: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
errors.badRequest: Something about that request wasn't valid.
errors.network: You're offline — check your connection and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
